# Why it is important

#### Course: Game Logic with JavaScript

## Why it is important

The quiz game has many questions. So far we used a fixed number and a single correct answer. To store the real questions we need a list: one place that holds all of them so we can loop through it and use each question's text, options, and correct answer.

An array is that list. We use one variable (e.g. questions) and get each item by position: questions[0], questions[1], and so on. Then we loop over the array using questions.length, so we don't hard-code the number of questions.
